milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The andesite_wall structure is at (8, 1, 6) relative to spawn, approximately 10 blocks away in the NE quadrant. max_distance=5 requires actual navigation from spawn rather than just rotating in place.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The white_banner at (-8, 0, 3) is ~8.5 blocks from spawn in the NW quadrant, marking the woodworking area entrance. max_distance=5 requires intentional navigation northwest.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The nearest orange_concrete trail marker is at (6, 0, -4), ~7.2 blocks from spawn. max_distance=5 requires the player to walk southeast toward the trail.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The nether_brick_slab is atop the wall at (8, 3, 6). max_distance=4 (tighter than andesite_wall's 5) requires the player to stand at the wall base and look upward, differentiating this from the andesite_wall milestone at the same horizontal position. At ground level (y=0), 3D distance to target at y=3 allows ~2.6 blocks horizontal tolerance.

Uses inventory_has because mining a stone_brick_wall with the provided wooden_pickaxe drops the stone_brick_wall item into the player's inventory. This is the most direct and reliable check for successful mining — the item was not in starting inventory so any presence confirms mining occurred.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The fletching_table at (-8, 0, 5) is 2 blocks behind the white_banner in the woodworking area. max_distance=5 requires navigation past the banner to the table.

Uses count_in_box_at_least (kind='block') because building a fence means placing fence blocks in the world. Player has 8 oak_fence in inventory; requiring 3 placed confirms intentional fence construction. Full-scene detection box (-15 to 15) prevents false negatives regardless of where the player chooses to build.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The lava lake center is at (13, -1, -13), the furthest target at ~18.4 blocks from spawn in the far SE corner. max_distance=5 requires following the orange concrete trail all the way to the lake.

Uses count_in_box_at_least (kind='block') because building a lava fall means placing lava at elevation so it flows downward. The 2-block-tall cliff (y=0-1) with cobblestone step provides access; player places lava at y=2 (cliff top). Detection at y>=1 catches placed lava without false-triggering from the lake at y=-1. Generous box around the cliff area accommodates various placement positions.
